summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a routine current report) furnishing its unaudited interim condensed and consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, together with Canadian-law CEO and CFO certifications. No transaction, stake, price, premium or corporate action is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary periodic financial reporting exhibit incorporated by reference into its Form F-3 shelf registrations. Brookfield Corporation holds roughly a 26.6% economic interest on a fully exchanged basis. Nothing here constitutes a special situation; risk-arb angle is nil, with attention limited to ordinary operating and leverage disclosures.
